workshoptitle: DB Security - Deep Data Security with Autonomous Database and MCP Server Tools

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Review the secure AI data access pattern, prerequisites, and expected outcome.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Explore the Environment
tutorials.description: Review the database, sample schema, sensitive data, users, and access paths.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Run the AI Application
tutorials.description: Configure and run the prebuilt simple AI application against Autonomous Database.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Connect MCP Server Tools
tutorials.description: Create or inspect OCI Database Tools MCP Server access and validate tool discovery.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Demonstrate AI Overreach
tutorials.description: Show how overprivileged AI and MCP access can expose sensitive data.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Apply and Test Deep Data Security
tutorials.description: Apply identity-aware data controls and validate least-privilege behavior across access paths.

tutorials.title: Optional Lab 6: Connect VS Code and Cline
tutorials.description: Connect Cline as an external MCP client and validate controlled Database Tools access.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Review Architecture, Clean Up, and Next Steps
tutorials.description: Review the secure AI access architecture, clean up resources, and plan next steps.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to Common Problems and Directions for Receiving Live Help
